title: Investigating binding of insecticide buprofezin to DNA by experimental and metadynamics simulation studies.
authors: Ponkarpagam, S; Vennila, K N; Elango, Kuppanagounder P
one_liner_zh: 该文结合实验与metadynamics模拟研究杀虫剂BUP与DNA的嵌入结合机制，虽非TF-DNA体系，但涉及蛋白-DNA互作建模方法，可迁移借鉴。
abstract: Buprofezin (BUP) is an insecticide which belongs to the thiadiazine structural family and known to damage DNA in mice. Though its toxic effect on human is not known clearly, understanding the mechanism of interaction of BUP with DNA can prove useful when required. Multi-spectroscopic experiments such as UV-Vis, fluorescence, circular dichroism (CD) and (1)H NMR coupled with viscosity measurements, urea effect and voltametric studies were performed to ascertain the mode of binding of BUP with calf thymus DNA (CT-DNA). Analysis of UV-Vis and fluorescence spectra indicated the formation of a complex between BUP and CT-DNA. Other experiments such as competitive binding assays with ethidium bromide (EB) and Hoechst 33258, viscosity measurements, effect of urea, CD, voltammetric studies and (1)H NMR spectral analysis suggested that BUP intercalates into the base pairs of CT-DNA. All these results revealed that the binding mode of BUP with CT-DNA should be intercalation and the binding constant is in the order of 10(4) M(-1). The DeltaH(o) < 0 and DeltaS(o) < 0 suggested that H-bonding or van der Waals force was the main binding force between BUP and CT-DNA. The proposed mode of binding of BUP with CT-DNA has been visualized using in silico molecular docking and metadynamics simulation studies, which showed that the phenyl ring of BUP binds to CT-DNA via pi-pi stacking interaction in addition to H-bond formation.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: Buprofezin (BUP) 是一种属于噻二嗪结构家族的杀虫剂，已知能损伤小鼠DNA。尽管其对人类的毒性作用尚不明确，但在需要时理解BUP与DNA相互作用的机制可能是有用的。通过多光谱实验，如紫外-可见光谱、荧光光谱、圆二色谱（CD）和(1)H NMR，结合粘度测量、尿素效应和伏安法研究，以确定BUP与小牛胸腺DNA（CT-DNA）的结合模式。紫外-可见光谱和荧光光谱分析表明BUP与CT-DNA之间形成了复合物。其他实验，如与溴化乙锭（EB）和Hoechst 33258的竞争性结合实验、粘度测量、尿素效应、CD、伏安法研究和(1)H NMR光谱分析，提示BUP嵌入到CT-DNA的碱基对中。所有结果表明，BUP与CT-DNA的结合模式应为嵌入方式，结合常数在10(4) M(-1)数量级。DeltaH(o) < 0 和 DeltaS(o) < 0 表明，氢键或范德华力是BUP与CT-DNA之间的主要结合力。通过计算机模拟分子对接和元动力学模拟研究，对BUP与CT-DNA的结合模式进行了可视化，结果显示BUP的苯环通过pi-pi堆积相互作用与CT-DNA结合，此外还形成氢键。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
